text_block_list.text: One day, upon returning to the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, seems there are no notable problems.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, regarding its durability and elasticity, it would be
prudent to conduct practical verification once more just to be certain.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I need to pay attention to my movements
and how I look on the concert stage too...

Biwa Hayahide seems to be checking
and recording various details about her racing attire.

"It's been a while since her Racewear arrived,
and we should have checked everything over during her first fitting, but—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, I would like to hear your opinion as well.
Compared to before, does anything seem off?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back.
I want to identify and record any points of concern.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You might call me a worrywart,
but it's my nature not to rest easy until all points of concern are eliminated.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since entering Tracen Academy,
I have witnessed countless formidable opponents.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"The truly strong adapt flexibly to unforeseen circumstances,
and won't hesitate to cast aside everything they've built up if push comes to shove—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
With an extraordinary strength that leaves everyone in awe,
she breaks through the dire situation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —However, that is not the case for me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even though I know I should follow their example,
I just can't let go of everything I've built up until now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That is why the only way to deal with it is to prepare beforehand until I'm sick of it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, this might mean we haven't managed
to break free from the realm of common sense."
choice_data_list: Why don't you try not taking notes instead?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...What does this mean?
choice_data_list: Could you let me see those notes?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I don't mind, but...

I took the note from her, and the moment I opened it,
I was astounded by the sheer amount of information packed inside.
"Course-by-course analysis of each racetrack, actual historical results, and the numerous preemptive measures derived from them—"
Recorded there were the countless trials and errors that Biwa Hayahide had carried out day after day...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, what's the matter?
Falling quiet like that—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

If we keep preparing, we can minimize unexpected events to near zero.
Once we do, you should be able to unleash your full potential.
However, that wasn't something just anyone could do. I told her that she could pull it off precisely because she was Biwa Hayahide, meticulously gathering and analyzing every detail.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see...
I suppose one could look at it that way too.
choice_data_list: Let's make the most of your one-of-a-kind weapon!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
One of a kind... If that's the case,
then there's no need to compare yourself to others.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Thanks to you,
I feel like a new path has opened up for me.

There is no single correct way to grow.
That is precisely why I wanted to continue
trial and error together with her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I've tried that several times already.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, it was no use. My anxiety simply wouldn't subside, and I found myself reaching for my notes before I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If... you truly intend to quit,
you probably need the resolve to tear it all to shreds.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
If it just vanished entirely, the regrets would disappear too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A note like this... that does nothing
but make excuses... ngh!!
I instinctively reached out to stop Biwa Hayahide, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ngh... As I thought, I can't do it...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To face such formidable foes without prior preparation...
I simply can't...!

Seeing Biwa Hayahide struggle like this,
changing our conventional approach might
not necessarily be the right answer.
If that's the case—
choice_data_list: Got it! There's no need to throw away your notes!
Got it! You don't need to throw away your notes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However...
choice_data_list: Hayahide should just do what she wants to do.

text_block_list.text:
I told her that addressing her concerns isn't wrong,
and that she should grow stronger
by making good use of her notes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Put it to use instead of throwing it away, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right... If I cannot cast it aside,
then I have no choice but to fight in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That takes a load off my mind.
Thank you, Trainer.

Afterward, the two of us sat down to discuss things while looking at her notes,
sorting out the immediate issues that needed to be addressed.
